name: Last Bastion
effect: Once per fight, when your fortress drops below 10% health, it takes no damage for 2 seconds.

name: Polar Flux
effect: Once per fight, below 50% health: a blast hits EVERYONE on the field for 30% of their max health.

name: Twin Citadels
effect: If both players use a Fortress I, your fortress takes 30% less damage.

name: Keen Edge
flavour: Sharpen the shot, not the blade.

name: Cannon Doctrine
effect: While your fortress is a Fortress I, your whole side deals +70% damage.
